schema_review.rationale: The shared s1300 -> s1400 -> s1401 chain registers installed 1.3.0 no-vector Server storage on SQLite, seekDB and OceanBase with Code disabled or enabled. SQLite/OceanBase Code caches remain separate; embedded seekDB Code uses the three frozen released tables. A selected vector profile binds the frozen schema and domain contract to the exact historical profile ID, model, dimension, distance and normalization. SQLite maintenance registers and backfills the Atomic vec0 helper and transactional triggers; native layouts preserve vector column dimensions and explicit HNSW parameters, including ordered key columns, algorithm, distance, library and construction/search options. Unknown index options remain rejected. The vector-only configuration declaration is not a second revision or recovery journal. Full layout and domain checks precede managed use; configured or injected model drift and missing helpers cannot trigger startup repair. No embedding provider is called during migration and historical embeddings, Topic shape, authority and evidence are preserved. Existing no-vector revision resources and all three checksums remain unchanged; selected vector profiles have separately bound checksums. Target locks, original recovery points, acknowledgements and backup policies remain shared. The declared installed-release gate still contains the six no-vector/Code cases; vector installed-artifact matrix and complete recovery/restore acceptance remain unfinished. Source tests and schema captures do not establish that release acceptance passed. Policy remains upgrade-required.
